description: Complete English companion to the unchanged Russian dialogue and storyboard masters. IDs define identity; localized names do not change gameplay IDs.

events.en: I'll find the lens before Mira ties another bow on me.
Start at the gate. One familiar step will take you toward the stream.
First trail crossed. Scarf still here. A good start.
The trail leads to the stream. Look at Fika's drawing.
I was so busy looking down the trail, I forgot the tile right ahead.
You can start this trail again. One step first, then the next.
We're at the gate. Choose 1, then Tish on the outlined tile.
A familiar gate. Choose 1, then Tish. Help has the details.
Choose step 1. It takes you to the next tile.
Now tap Tish on the outlined tile. He'll take the step you chose.
One tile. Even my other ear kept up!
New turn, new step 1. Choose it, then Tish again.
That tile is empty. Tap Tish where he's standing.
We move from the gate toward the exit. Steps count the tiles ahead of Tish.
Choose a step, then a hero on the trail. That's the order.
You know this step now. Try on your own; Help is always there.
Our goal is to cross the trail and move beyond the last tile.
The last tile. Choose 1, then Tish. He'll step out of the trail.
Tish is through. This trail needed one hero to reach the exit.
Choose 1, then Tish. Repeat until he's beyond the last tile.
Tiles across the stream. Good. I'm wearing my celebration boots.
First check where the step will land. The tiles can keep your boots dry.
Dry boots. I can hardly believe it. Better check again.
The bridge is next. That's where we agreed to meet.
I think I was choosing the prettiest splash instead of a tile.
If you lose your way, start at the stream again and check each landing.
We're at the stream. One turn means step 1 or 2. Choose a distance, then Tish.
Back at the stream. Choose 1 or 2, then Tish. Any available move is fine.
Choose 1 or 2. Tish uses only one of these steps each turn.
Try 1, then Tish. He'll land on the next tile.
Short and dry. I approve of this trail.
Now look at 2. It takes you two tiles ahead.
The outline shows where Tish will land. Tap him to move two tiles.
Two tiles, three times the dignity.
That move ended the turn. The unused step doesn't carry over; new choices appear.
Before Tish moves, you can change the selected step. Check both distances.
If a step reaches or passes the exit, Tish finishes the trail.
That step belonged to the last turn. Choose one of the steps available now.
The exit is close. Either available step will take Tish to the bank.
One turn: 1 or 2. Choose a step, then Tish. Lead him to the exit.
I thought I'd cross alone. This bridge seems to have room for friends.
I want to bring the light back too. And go farther than the gate with you.
It's more fun together. Even the boards creak in harmony.
Both safely across. Let's find Grandpa Koren. He knows the old trail.
My thoughts reached the workshop before I checked where we both were.
The bridge can wait. Let's try again and get each friend across.
We're on the bridge. Choose 1 or 2, then either of us. Both must reach the exit.
Together at the bridge again. One step for one hero each turn. Lead both out.
There are two of us now. Choose a step, then a friend. Both must reach the exit.
Try 2, then Tish. I'll wait at the start for now.
Now try 2 for me. Tap Jo. We'll meet on the same tile.
A sturdy tile. Room for two friends, no waiting!
One hero uses the whole step. You can't split 2 into one tile each.
Either of us can move next if the move is available. We don't have to take turns.
One friend is through; the other is still on the trail. The counter shows how many have reached the exit.
A hero can exit as soon as their step reaches the edge. No need to wait for the other on the last tile.
That friend is already through. Choose someone still on the trail.
See who's farther from the exit. You can give them the next step to bring us closer.
When we're on the same tile, tap the hero or their portrait in the list. The name shows who will move.
Choose 1 or 2, then one friend. Friends can share a tile; both must reach the exit.
Lantern packed. Treats packed. Good spirits packed too.
An old trail, a simple rule: first check where you'll land.
Everyone's through. The beetle didn't even wake up. Very polite of us.
Thank you, Grandpa Koren. We'll carry the little lantern to Kloch.
Ready to try again. Just tell me where to stand and how far to go.
Back to the workshop. Check your landing; it says more than a long speech.
We're at the workshop. Choose 1 or 2 for one friend. Don't land on the beetle's tile.
Back among the roots. Don't stop on the beetle's tile. You can cross it to reach a clear landing.
Boom is with us. Lead all three out. Choose his steps the same way.
The counter must reach 3 of 3. We'll carry the little lantern together.
Start with a familiar move: 2 for Tish. That landing is clear.
The beetle is sleeping on that tile. You can't land there. Look at 1.
The tile before the beetle is clear. Give Tish 1 to stop beside it.
Now 2 takes you past the beetle. You can cross an occupied tile if the landing is clear.
1 or 2 for me too? Good. A clear plan makes a steady step.
Friends can share a tile. The beetle is the obstacle here, not our company.
That step lands on the beetle. It hasn't been used. Choose another step or another friend.
One friend is through. Keep moving the two still on the trail.
A friend at the edge can use their step to exit. Then lead the others out.
1 or 2 for one friend. Cross the beetle's tile, but don't land on it. Lead all three out.
Who's first to the bank? My victory crest is ready!
I've brought my friends. Everyone across: that's my finish line.
Everyone's on the bank. Now there's time to fix your crest.
Your finish line was wider than mine. May I join you at the table?
I lost track of the crossing. I was only looking ahead of myself again.
Let's start from this bank again. First, look at both steps and all our friends.
We're at the crossing. 1 and 2 are separate moves. Use the available steps to lead all three out.
Back at the crossing. After our whole turn, Rusty moves one tile forward. Check each landing.
Now we have 1 and 2: two separate moves each turn. Use one, then the remaining step.
Try 2 for Tish. Step 1 will remain for the next move.
Step 1 remains. You can give it to Jo: choose that step, then me.
Rusty waits until our turn ends. That's usually after both separate moves.
One tile! With magnificent momentum!
2 lands on Rusty. You can't stop there. Check 1 for Tish.
1 takes Tish to the clear tile before Rusty. That's our first move.
Step 2 remains. Give it to Jo and I'll join Tish on his tile. Then Rusty will move.
Give both steps to one friend or to different friends. Each move is separate; check each landing.
After our turn, Rusty moves one tile forward. The marker shows his next tile.
Company already? All right, I'll step aside. Finish in style!
Two separate steps. Choose clear landings, allow for Rusty's move, and lead all three out.
We have the lens. Now we're all heading home, just as we promised.
One last trail to the clearing. Our wedding isn't the only thing that needs the light.
Everyone's home. Now I know what a hero needs: friends and room at the table.
We've brought the light and the guests. Grandpa Koren, time to light the lantern!
We're so close. But I can't do everyone's hurrying for them.
We can try this last trail again. Choose a step and help each friend along.
We have the lens. Two separate steps; one tile occupied by the beetle. Lead all three to the lantern.
Back on the last trail. Familiar steps, clear landings, and every friend at the exit.
Lead all three to the lantern. You know the steps; Help is here if you need it.
Choose 1 or 2 for the first move. Then use the remaining step.
The beetle has a tile again. Check the landing. You can cross an occupied tile on the way.
Any friend with an available move can go. See who needs this step most.
1 and 2 are separate moves. Don't add the numbers into one big jump.
Friends can share a tile. Each will take their own step afterward.
I'll hold a place at the table. You keep going. Room for everyone!
One friend remains. Give them the available steps until they reach the exit.
Reaching or passing the edge is enough. Tap a hero with an available step to the exit.
I think the trail makes more sense now. Or maybe I'm finally listening to my friends.
Three of three. We brought the lens back together. Time to light the clearing.
Choose a remaining step and a friend. Don't land on the beetle. Lead everyone to the lantern.
First choose a step, then a hero on the trail.
Choose a hero on an outlined tile. Their portrait and name can help you find them.
That friend is already through. Choose someone still on the trail.
The landing is occupied. Your step is unused. Choose another available move.
No hero can use this step right now. Check another step.
No step has a clear landing right now. The turn will end, then we'll check the next steps.
Let our friend finish moving. Then choose the next step.
Rusty is moving now. After his step, we'll choose ours again.
That step is finished. Choose one that's available now.
This step won't take that friend to the exit yet. You can move farther along the trail.
Keep going at your own pace. You can open the hints again in Help.
Even heroes can take a break. We'll continue when you're ready.
What shall we look at: steps, choosing a friend, clear landings, or the exit?
Outlines and icons show available moves. Color helps, and so do names and shapes.
The line stays until you close it. You can adjust the text size.
We'll continue from the same hint in your chosen language.
You can reduce motion. The steps and hints will stay the same.
This trail couldn't be resumed. Start it again; we'll show a short hint.

scenes.title: A Clue the Little Ones Found

frames.title: At the Edge of the Yard

storyLines.en: Everything will be just right today.
Good is good enough.
Just borrowing it until the celebration!
But the celebration is here…
I'll bring the lens back. Won't take long.
I'll check the bridge. Meet you there.
Uncle Tish! We found the way!
I found north.
And I found a feather by the stream.
Thank you. I'm trusting you with the garland.
You're here already.
The bridge is checked. We'll go to Grandpa Koren together.
I wanted to manage on my own…
You can manage with me too.
Without that lens, even the trail is dimmer.
Everyone needs the big light. The little one can be shared.
I'll carry it. Carefully.
I've got the door. All three of us, let's go.
Now I understand.
He doesn't like hurrying either.
The clearing's close. But Rusty's called another race.
Who's first to the clearing?
What matters is that we all get there.
You arrived together. That's a skill too!
Just how we wanted it.
Why do you need our lens?
So guests can find my table…
This one's for you. And there's a place with us at the table.
I didn't ask. I'm sorry. I'll give everyone's light back.
Thank you. It would have been harder alone.
There. The light's where it belongs.
Shall we choose our path together?
And make room for each other, every day.
Next time I'll ask. Even if it sparkles.
Tiny handkerchief. Big happiness.
